title: ticfac triage <epic>: settle findings without 64-hex keys
description: Interactive triage over the untriaged findings of an epic: for each, show kind, severity, title, body and discovering tick, and offer absorb into this epic (creates the tick and blocks the close-out on it), file as a backlog tick, fixed-as <commit>, or discard, with the actor defaulting from git config. --json lists them and accepts decisions by short key prefix for agents. Replaces 'ticfac finding --promote-as X --by who <epic> <64-hex>' for everyday use.
